description: Recolour a sprite or sheet without touching its pixels' shapes: remap to a classic palette (PICO-8, Game Boy, Sweetie 16, Endesga 32, C64), shift hue for team colours and enemy tiers (only the uniform if you say which colour), swap exact colours, several versions in one call. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

customPalette.description: Or your own palette as hex colours.

dither.description: Ordered dithering when remapping to a palette: keeps gradients readable with few colours.

hueShift.description: Rotate hues by this many degrees.

hueWidth.description: How far in degrees from onlyHue a colour may be and still change.

image.description: Base64 PNG or WebP with transparency.

onlyHue.description: Shift only colours close in hue to this one and leave skin, metal and outlines alone: give the red of the uniform to recolour just the uniform.

palette.description: Remap every colour to a known palette: pico8, gameboy, sweetie16, endesga32, c64, cga, gray4, 1bit.

variants.description: Make this many versions, the hue shift spread evenly around the wheel after the first: team colours or enemy tiers in one call.

name: sprite_tools_recolor
